description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the location where log files should be stored. Local and UNC paths are accepted. Default is %ProgramData%\FSLogix\Logs

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Logging\LogDir
Type:  REG_SZ
